meta.interpretation: The user wants to know which countries host the most currently recruiting clinical trials for type 2 diabetes, ranked by trial count and shown geographically.
assumptions: 'Recruiting' interpreted strictly as overall status RECRUITING, excluding 'not yet recruiting' and 'enrolling by invitation'.
No date window applied — all currently recruiting trials regardless of start year.
Both interventional and observational studies included, since the question is not phase-specific.
The condition term 'type 2 diabetes' is passed as written, so the API's synonym/MeSH expansion (Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2) applies.
A trial running in several countries contributes to each of those countries; top 30 countries shown.
meta.counting_semantics: A trial may report several values for country, so it is counted once per value. Bucket values therefore sum to more than the number of trials.
